text: When compaction has reported success from onCompactionComplete, preserve recovery files if the later mbox or database install fails. The two files cannot be renamed atomically as a pair; .compacting, .compacted, and .original files show which stage was reached and allow later recovery. This revision did not yet add automatic recovery.
title: Keep recovery files when compaction reaches its commit phase
